business_impact.basis: lost morning sales from walkouts, June-July actuals x 2

goal.statement: Install a second espresso machine at the main counter to eliminate rush-hour wait times by September 1

problem_statement.what: Morning rush orders back up at the espresso bar because we only have one machine, so we need to buy a second espresso machine

risks.mitigation: Order this week from the backup supplier
risks.risk: Second machine lead time may exceed 4 weeks

scope.in_scope: Espresso bar station during weekday morning rush (7-9am)
scope.out_scope: Drip coffee, pastry case, afternoon/evening service
